---
title: Studies
---

```{r}
world <- metawoRld::load_metawoRld(".", verbose = FALSE)
st <- world$studies
link <- paste0("study/", utils::URLencode(metawoRld::sanitize_id(st$study_id), reserved = TRUE), ".html")
title <- if ("title" %in% names(st)) st$title else st$study_id
st$title <- paste0("<a href='", link, "'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(title), "</a>")
show <- intersect(c("title", "authors", "year", "journal", "country", "study_design"), names(st))
```

The review includes `r nrow(st)` studies. Click a title to see the study's details and data.

```{r}
DT::datatable(
  st[, show, drop = FALSE],
  escape = setdiff(seq_along(show), 1),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 25, autoWidth = TRUE)
)
```
